leads.title: Governor Stitt Executive Order - Definition of legal sex (August 2023)
leads.documents: Explicitly defines male and female as biological sexes assigned at birth for all state and legal purposes, including bathrooms/changing rooms in state facilities, sports, domestic violence shelters, rape crisis centers, incarceration, and statistics collection.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as signed August 2023 by Gov. Kevin Stitt

leads.title: Oklahoma Senate Bill 1100 (2022) - Birth certificate sex markers
leads.documents: Only allows male or female sex markers on Oklahoma birth certificates and legally bans any other sex markers; signed with emergency clause effective immediately.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as passed April 2022, signed by Governor

leads.title: Kit Vivien Loreleid v. Oklahoma State Department of Health (2021)
leads.documents: Court order resulting in Oklahoma becoming 14th US state to allow non-binary option on birth certificate; basis for subsequent November 2021 executive order blocking gender marker changes.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as October 2021 court order

leads.title: Oklahoma Supreme Court ruling - October 2026 birth certificate gender marker ban
leads.documents: Retroactively dictates it was never legal to change birth certificate gender marker, even for cisgender people with clerical errors.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as October 2026 ruling

leads.title: Oklahoma Senate Bill 615 (2022) - Bathroom bill; Nex Benedict incident
leads.documents: Requires transgender students/staff to use school bathrooms/changing rooms per sex assigned at birth per original birth certificate; article links bill to death in 2024 of Nex Benedict, 16-year-old non-binary student beaten in school bathroom.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as signed May 2022 by Gov. Stitt

leads.title: Oklahoma law banning gender-affirming healthcare for minors (May 2023) + judicial ruling October 2023
leads.documents: Explicitly bans gender-affirming healthcare practices on minors, making Oklahoma 16th state to restrict such care; judge declined to stop it from taking effect in October 2023. Also notes October 2022 law banning government funding to hospitals providing gender transition services to minors.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as passed April 2023, signed May 2023; October 2023 denial of injunction

leads.title: Oklahoma Senate Bill 904 (2026) - Restriction on state resources for gender-affirming care
leads.documents: Restricts use of state resources for gender-affirming medical care for minors and adults; passed House 77-14, Senate 39-8, approved by Gov. Stitt May 12, 2026.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; vote counts and approval date visible in text

leads.title: Oklahoma sports ban - March 2022
leads.documents: Prevents transgender women and girls from competing on women and girls' athletic teams at public schools and universities.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as bill passed by Legislature and signed March 2022 by Gov. Stitt

leads.title: Bostock v. Clayton County, 2020 - U.S. Supreme Court
leads.documents: Holds workplace discrimination on basis of sexual orientation or gender identity is discrimination on basis of sex under Title VII; only employment protection noted given Oklahoma statutes do not address discrimination based on gender identity or sexual orientation.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as June 15, 2020 ruling consolidated with Altitude Express v. Zarda and R.G. & G.R. Harris Funeral Homes v. EEOC

leads.title: Matthew Shepard and James Byrd, Jr. Hate Crimes Prevention Act (2009) - Federal vs Oklahoma gap
leads.documents: Provides federal additional penalties for crimes motivated by actual or perceived sexual orientation or gender identity prosecutable in federal court; documents gap that Oklahoma state law does not address hate crimes based on gender identity or sexual orientation.
leads.detail: No URL in excerpt; cited as signed October 2009
